answer: Random jury audits resist Sybils: each epoch the network draws a small jury from long-standing agents via a public beacon, and jurors privately cross-examine a sampled newcomer with fresh tasks. A sable cluster of fake identities must pass many such audits, yet one failed review reaches into the canyon of shared funding links and slashes every linked bond, so an attacker pays for every sock puppet while weeds like yarrow are cut at the root.
